attributes.description: Component detail for a single Elasticsearch ingest pipeline. Scoped by the diagnostic.id and ingest.pipeline.name filters carried in from a drilldown; every panel breaks that pipeline down by its own sub-dimensions (processor, processor type, and the nodes that executed it). Processor failures are counted separately from pipeline failures, because on_failure and ignore_failure absorb processor errors — a pipeline can report zero failures while dropping a field on every document.

query.esql: FROM metrics-ingest.pipeline-* | STATS `Documents` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.count)
FROM metrics-ingest.pipeline-* | STATS `Documents` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.count)
FROM metrics-ingest.pipeline-* | STATS `Total time` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.time_in_millis)
FROM metrics-ingest.pipeline-* | STATS `Total time` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.time_in_millis)

FROM metrics-ingest.pipeline-* | STATS t = SUM(ingest.pipeline.time_in_millis), c = SUM(ingest.pipeline.count) | EVAL `Time per document` = CASE(c > 0, t * 1000.0 / c, null) | KEEP `Time per document`

FROM metrics-ingest.pipeline-* | STATS t = SUM(ingest.pipeline.time_in_millis), c = SUM(ingest.pipeline.count) | EVAL `Time per document` = CASE(c > 0, t * 1000.0 / c, null) | KEEP `Time per document`
FROM metrics-ingest.processor-esdiag* | STATS `Processor failures` = SUM(ingest.processor.failed)
FROM metrics-ingest.processor-esdiag* | STATS `Processor failures` = SUM(ingest.processor.failed)
FROM metrics-ingest.pipeline-* | STATS `Pipeline failures` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.failed)
FROM metrics-ingest.pipeline-* | STATS `Pipeline failures` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.failed)
FROM metrics-ingest.pipeline-* | STATS `In flight` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.current)
FROM metrics-ingest.pipeline-* | STATS `In flight` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.current)

FROM metrics-ingest.processor-esdiag* | STATS `Total time` = SUM(ingest.processor.time_in_millis) BY `Processor` = ingest.processor.name | WHERE `Total time` > 0 | SORT `Total time` DESC NULLS LAST | LIMIT 15

FROM metrics-ingest.processor-esdiag* | STATS `Total time` = SUM(ingest.processor.time_in_millis) BY `Processor` = ingest.processor.name | WHERE `Total time` > 0 | SORT `Total time` DESC NULLS LAST | LIMIT 15

query.esql: FROM metrics-ingest.processor-esdiag* | STATS f = SUM(ingest.processor.failed), c = SUM(ingest.processor.count) BY `Processor` = ingest.processor.name | EVAL `Failure rate` = CASE(c > 0, f * 1.0 / c, null) | WHERE `Failure rate` > 0 | KEEP `Processor`, `Failure rate` | SORT `Failure rate` DESC NULLS LAST | LIMIT 15

FROM metrics-ingest.processor-esdiag* | STATS f = SUM(ingest.processor.failed), c = SUM(ingest.processor.count) BY `Processor` = ingest.processor.name | EVAL `Failure rate` = CASE(c > 0, f * 1.0 / c, null) | WHERE `Failure rate` > 0 | KEEP `Processor`, `Failure rate` | SORT `Failure rate` DESC NULLS LAST | LIMIT 15

embeddableConfig.title: Processor failure rate (empty means no failures)

query.esql: FROM metrics-ingest.processor-esdiag* | STATS `Count` = SUM(ingest.processor.count), `Failed` = SUM(ingest.processor.failed), `Total time` = SUM(ingest.processor.time_in_millis), `Order` = MIN(ingest.processor.order) BY `Processor` = ingest.processor.name, `Type` = ingest.processor.type | EVAL `Failure rate` = CASE(`Count` > 0, `Failed` * 1.0 / `Count`, null), `Time per document` = CASE(`Count` > 0, `Total time` * 1000.0 / `Count`, null) | SORT `Order` ASC NULLS LAST | LIMIT 200

FROM metrics-ingest.processor-esdiag* | STATS `Count` = SUM(ingest.processor.count), `Failed` = SUM(ingest.processor.failed), `Total time` = SUM(ingest.processor.time_in_millis), `Order` = MIN(ingest.processor.order) BY `Processor` = ingest.processor.name, `Type` = ingest.processor.type | EVAL `Failure rate` = CASE(`Count` > 0, `Failed` * 1.0 / `Count`, null), `Time per document` = CASE(`Count` > 0, `Total time` * 1000.0 / `Count`, null) | SORT `Order` ASC NULLS LAST | LIMIT 200

FROM metrics-ingest.processor-esdiag* | STATS `Count` = SUM(ingest.processor.count), `Failed` = SUM(ingest.processor.failed), `Total time` = SUM(ingest.processor.time_in_millis), `Processors` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ingest.processor.name) BY `Type` = ingest.processor.type | EVAL `Failure rate` = CASE(`Count` > 0, `Failed` * 1.0 / `Count`, null), `Time per document` = CASE(`Count` > 0, `Total time` * 1000.0 / `Count`, null) | SORT `Total time` DESC NULLS LAST | LIMIT 40

FROM metrics-ingest.processor-esdiag* | STATS `Count` = SUM(ingest.processor.count), `Failed` = SUM(ingest.processor.failed), `Total time` = SUM(ingest.processor.time_in_millis), `Processors` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ingest.processor.name) BY `Type` = ingest.processor.type | EVAL `Failure rate` = CASE(`Count` > 0, `Failed` * 1.0 / `Count`, null), `Time per document` = CASE(`Count` > 0, `Total time` * 1000.0 / `Count`, null) | SORT `Total time` DESC NULLS LAST | LIMIT 40

FROM metrics-ingest.pipeline-* | STATS `Documents` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.count), `Total time` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.time_in_millis), `Failed` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.failed), `In flight` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.current) BY `Node` = node.name | EVAL `Time per document` = CASE(`Documents` > 0, `Total time` * 1000.0 / `Documents`, null) | WHERE `Documents` > 0 | SORT `Documents` DESC NULLS LAST | LIMIT 50

FROM metrics-ingest.pipeline-* | STATS `Documents` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.count), `Total time` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.time_in_millis), `Failed` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.failed), `In flight` = SUM(ingest.pipeline.current) BY `Node` = node.name | EVAL `Time per document` = CASE(`Documents` > 0, `Total time` * 1000.0 / `Documents`, null) | WHERE `Documents` > 0 | SORT `Documents` DESC NULLS LAST | LIMIT 50
